reason: Methodology-driven reset. The active book contains a known-invalid Toronto 2026-04-01 14+ trade generated before the final Toronto fix stack was deployed. Root causes: (1) bucket parser failed to discover individual Celsius degree buckets, collapsing a full 11-bucket market to just '14+'; (2) Gaussian fallback created a live trade from a tail bucket instead of passing; (3) Celsius display rounding used an incorrect F-roundtrip (10.3°C → 11 instead of 10); (4) streak scoring used reconstructed floats instead of canonical accuracy cache. All trades in this era mix pre-fix and post-fix logic. Resetting to create a clean post-fix book.
fix_deployed: Five fixes deployed: (1) _extract_bucket_from_text now handles exact Celsius degree buckets and 'or below' patterns; (2) Gaussian fallback constrained to buckets within ±1°C/±2°F of working center, else PASS; (3) streak scoring uses canonical accuracy_rows_cache.json hit/miss booleans (same source as dashboard); (4) bimodal cluster detection on top-tier streak models — if dominant streak support splits between two separated buckets, selects both instead of averaging; (5) Celsius display rounding fixed: direct _round_half_up, no F-roundtrip. All fixes covered by 19 regression tests in test_toronto_regression.py.
